high_level_description: The image is a news article headline from Fintrackr, dated February 8, 2024, authored by Kunal Manchanda & Harsh Upadhyay. The headline reads: "Infra.Market posts Rs 11,846 Cr gross revenue in FY23; remains profitable." The article discusses the performance of Infra.Market, a construction goods and services platform based in Mumbai. It highlights that despite experiencing hyper-growth with over a 9X surge in gross scale during the last two fiscal years, the company has maintained profitability. Key points from the article: Gross revenue
